name: BlogBotz – AI Blog Automation
author: BlogBotz

sections.description:
Creating high-quality blog content consistently is hard. Finding topics, writing long posts, optimizing for SEO, and publishing on time takes hours — and most sites simply fall behind.

BlogBotz solves this by automating your entire blogging workflow.

BlogBotz is an AI-powered blog automation platform that continuously researches, writes, and publishes SEO‑optimized, long‑form blog posts directly to your WordPress site — so you can grow traffic without writing everything yourself.

Who is BlogBotz for?

  • Bloggers and niche site owners who want consistent content
  • WooCommerce store owners who want more organic traffic
  • Agencies managing multiple WordPress sites
  • Website owners who want SEO growth without daily effort

If your site needs fresh content to rank, BlogBotz does the heavy lifting.

What makes BlogBotz different?

Unlike basic AI writers, BlogBotz focuses on:

  • Human‑readable, well‑structured articles
  • SEO‑friendly formatting with headings and internal links
  • Native WordPress publishing via the REST API
  • Full control over drafts vs auto‑publish

Your content fits naturally into your site — it does not feel auto‑generated or out of place.

Key Features

  • AI Content Generation – Automatically generate long‑form blog posts tailored to your niche, categories, tone, and language preferences.
  • SEO Optimization – Posts are structured with keywords, headings, and metadata to improve search visibility and readability.
  • Scheduled Publishing – Maintain a consistent content calendar with automated publishing schedules.
  • Smart Internal Linking – Automatically adds relevant internal links to improve SEO and user engagement.
  • WooCommerce Integration – Include product references and recommendations inside blog posts for ecommerce stores.
  • Multi‑language Support – Generate blog content in multiple languages to reach a global audience.
  • Draft or Auto‑Publish Control – Choose full autopilot publishing or review posts as drafts before going live.

How it works

  1. Connect – Link your WordPress site to BlogBotz using secure one‑click authentication.
  2. Configure – Select categories, tone, posting schedule, and language preferences.
  3. Automate – BlogBotz researches topics, writes posts, and publishes them automatically.

Full ownership and control

BlogBotz uses the WordPress REST API, so:

  • All content is created as regular WordPress posts.
  • You fully own and control every article.
  • You can edit, delete, or repurpose content at any time.

There is no lock‑in and no hidden publishing — everything lives in your own WordPress site.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher (required for Application Passwords)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • A BlogBotz account (auto-created on connection)

Privacy & Data

This plugin connects to BlogBotz servers (https://blogbotz.com) to provide its functionality.

Data Transmitted:

  • Site URL and site name (for identification)
  • Admin email address (for account creation/login)
  • Site categories and pages (for content context)
  • WordPress REST API credentials (Application Password, stored securely)

Data NOT Transmitted:

  • Visitor/user data from your website
  • Post content you create manually
  • Personal data of your website users

How Data Is Used:

  • To authenticate your connection to BlogBotz
  • To generate relevant content for your site
  • To publish content via WordPress REST API

Third-Party Service:

This plugin requires an active connection to BlogBotz (https://blogbotz.com), a third-party service.

  • BlogBotz Terms of Service
  • BlogBotz Privacy Policy

No tracking or analytics code is included in this plugin. All data transmission requires explicit user action (clicking “Connect”).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the blogbotz folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to BlogBotz in the admin menu
  4. Click ‘Connect to BlogBotz’ to link your site
  5. Log in or create a BlogBotz account
  6. Authorize the connection
sections.faq:
Do I need a BlogBotz account?

Yes, you need a free BlogBotz account to use this plugin. You can sign up at https://blogbotz.com/register

Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free. BlogBotz offers both free and premium plans for content generation.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! BlogBotz integrates with WooCommerce to include product recommendations in your blog posts.

Can I review content before publishing?

Yes, you can configure BlogBotz to save posts as drafts for review before publishing.

What languages are supported?

BlogBotz supports content generation in multiple languages. Check the BlogBotz dashboard for the current list of supported languages.

Is my data secure?

Yes, we use secure API keys and encrypted connections. We only access data necessary for content generation.
